mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, with potential for increased dronedarone levels and QT prolongation risk; febuxostat may increase uric acid rebound upon discontinuation affecting arrhythmia control.
action: Monitor QTc interval and dronedarone levels; consider alternative xanthine oxidase inhibitor (allopurinol) if arrhythmia management is critical; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
